## Page 1
Regret Bounds for Online Convex Optimization with Delayed Feedback
Dan Prover, Erin Proof
Department of Mathematics, Example University
Abstract
We prove a new regret bound for online convex optimization when feedback arrives with delay. We establish a lower bound that
matches the upper bound up to logarithmic factors and derive a convergence rate for the adaptive step size. No experiments with
neural network layers or blocks are included; the analysis applies to general convex losses.
